# #4544: Patch: follow-up to #4531 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4531 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4531 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45092593831)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`25c463cc105a`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4531 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx:534`: The new prompt test passes the same JSX element object to `rerender`. React skips that render at the root, so neither `Prompt` nor `CardOption` runs again, and the test would pass without the `useMemo` in `CardOption`. Nothing tests the acceptance item 'a board re-render that leaves a picker's options unchanged builds no option's face'.
  Evidence: The test builds `const tree = (<CatalogContext.Provider value={lookup}><Prompt view={view} onAction={vi.fn()} /></CatalogContext.Provider>)` once, then calls `render(tree)` and `rerender(tree)`. RTL's `rerender` calls `root.render(ui)` with that same element. React's `updateHostRoot` sees `nextChildren === prevChildren` and stops there, and the Provider's value is unchanged, so `CardOption` never re-renders. Under the old code (inline `faceModel` per render) `faceCalls` would also be 0 after this rerender, so `toHaveLength(0)` holds either way. Fix: rerender a fresh element that re-renders `Prompt` with the same `view`, for example `rerender(<CatalogContext.Provider value={lookup}><Prompt view={view} onAction={vi.fn()} /></CatalogContext.Provider>)`, so the new `onAction` prop makes `Prompt` and its options render again. Then check it fails with the memo reverted. The collection hover test and the stats keystroke test do trigger real re-renders and are fine.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45093645053)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix the `#4511` prompt memo test in [PromptCards.test.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx) so its board re-render actually re-renders `Prompt` and its `CardOption` children with the picker's options unchanged, then asserts no option face is rebuilt. The language-switch half of the same test is already a real re-render and stays as is. No production code changes.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| [apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx) | change | Only the `#4511` test at line 534: build a fresh JSX element for the `rerender` call instead of reusing the `tree` object (lines 536-549) |

Do not touch anything else: not [Prompt.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx) (`CardOption`'s `useMemo`), not [faces.ts](/apps/web/src/game/faces.ts), not the collection hover test, not the stats keystroke test, not any crate, spec, or ruling. No spec section or ruling governs this change; it is a test-only correction of #4531's test, so no new ruling note and no `spec/pending` entry.

## Steps

1. In [PromptCards.test.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx), open the test `it("#4511 a board re-render ...", ...)` (line 534) and read lines 535-550: `view` from `discoverView()`, `tree` built once, `render(tree)`, `faceCalls.length = 0`, then the broken `rerender(tree)`.
2. Replace only line 549, `rerender(tree);`, with a fresh element that re-renders `Prompt` with the same `view` and unchanged options but a new `onAction` identity so `Prompt` and its options render again (copy the fresh-element shape from the passing scroll test in [OwnedCards.render.test.tsx](/apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.render.test.tsx) lines 109-119, which passes new props to `rerender` rather than reusing the old element):
```tsx
rerender(
  <CatalogContext.Provider value={lookup}>
    <Prompt view={view} onAction={vi.fn()} />
  </CatalogContext.Provider>,
);
```
Keep `view` the same object, `lookup` the same provider value, `faceCalls.length = 0` before it, and the existing `expect(faceCalls.filter((request) => request.call === "card")).toHaveLength(0);` after it unchanged. Delete or stop using the now-unneeded `tree` variable (either inline the first `render(...)` with the same fresh JSX or keep `tree` only for the initial `render`).
3. Leave the rest of the test untouched: the `DISCOVER` option presence checks, the `optionCalls` helper, and the `await act(async () => { await setLocale("zh-CN"); })` block with its rebuild assertions.
4. Negative control (local check only, not committed): temporarily revert the memo in `CardOption` in [Prompt.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx) (lines 931-954, the `useMemo` wrapping `liveFace`/`faceModel` plus `pricedFace`) to a direct per-render computation, run the test file, and confirm the board re-render assertion now fails (face calls > 0). Then restore [Prompt.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx) byte-for-byte (`git diff -- apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx` must be empty afterward).

## Tests

- Test file: [apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx](/apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx), existing test `#4511 a board re-render that leaves the picker's options unchanged builds no option's face, and a language switch rebuilds every face`. No new test names; the fixed test is the test. It asserts: after clearing `faceCalls`, the fresh-element rerender with identical options produces zero `call === "card"` face calls; after `setLocale("zh-CN")`, every `DISCOVER` defId has `optionCalls(defId) > 0`.
- Negative control: same file with the `useMemo` in `CardOption` temporarily reverted (step 4) — the zero-face-calls assertion must fail, proving the test exercises the memo.
- Commands (in this order, from the repo root):
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx` (rebuilds the WASM module the web tests load, then runs the file; all tests in it pass, including the negative-control failure while the memo is reverted and the pass once restored)
  - `cargo jackioh spec check` is not affected (no ruling added or cited); run it only if anything outside the test file changed, which should not happen.

## Done when

- [ ] The `#4511` board re-render assertion uses a fresh JSX element in `rerender`, not the reused `tree` object.
- [ ] The fixed test passes with the `useMemo` in place and was observed to fail with the `useMemo` temporarily reverted (memo reverted only for the check, fully restored after).
- [ ] The language-switch half of the same test is unchanged and passing.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx` is green; no test skipped, ignored, weakened, or deleted to get there.
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` shows changes only under `apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx` (plus no committed changes at all; the harness commits).

## Risks

- Reusing any part of the old element (same `onAction` closure, same `tree`) could still bail out the render; the fix avoids this by constructing brand-new JSX with a new `vi.fn()` each time, so `Prompt` props always change identity while option contents stay equal.
- Touching `CardOption`'s dependency array or `liveFace`/`faceModel` wiring would risk face staleness (wrong language, cost, or field power) for a test-only issue; the builder changes no production code, so this risk is avoided by construction.
- Locale leakage between tests (`setLocale("zh-CN")`) is already handled by the file's `afterEach` (`resetLocaleForTests`), which stays untouched.

## Open questions

None.
